description: Use this when an owner wants their place off Phorme for now. Confirm with the owner first, and set confirmation to true only after they said yes. Its page, the app's map and the Phorme connector stop listing it; its details and classes are kept, so it can be put live again. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the place.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the owner said yes to taking this place down.

place_id.description: The place_id of one of the owner's places, from get_gym_report or create_or_claim_place.

name: unpublish_place

place.description: The place: place_id, name, kind, line, city, country, address, hours, about, book_url, request_email, prices, phone, timezone, status (draft or live), page_url, upcoming_classes, brain_id, on_plan, held_requests and plan_url (the plan on phor.me, a price-free link; null when on the plan).

title: Take my place down
